notes: for-in over non-row iterables (axis.w for_expression sub_type kinds): strings yield 1-char strings, vecs yield int components, mats yield columns as vecs (mat:[[1,2,3],[4,5,6]] is the 3x2 transpose; columns print [ 1, 2, 3 ],[ 4, 5, 6 ]), ratvecs yield rats; '@' index counts over the iteration order; body-tilde reversal applies to every kind. Rust currently rejects all non-row iterables (Cannot iterate over value of type ...).
